class Payload:
    n: i64


enum Color:
    red,
    blue


union Choice:
    none,
    value: Payload


union Scalar:
    empty,
    number: i64


def make[T: integer](value: T) -> Choice:
    return Choice.value(Payload(n=i64(value)))


def score[T](context: T, value: Choice) -> i64:
    _ = context
    match value:
        case Choice.none:
            return 0
        case Choice.value(payload):
            return payload.n


def scalar[T](context: T, value: Scalar) -> i64:
    _ = context
    match value:
        case Scalar.empty:
            return 0
        case Scalar.number(payload):
            return payload


def table[T: integer](value: T) -> [Color]i64:
    return {Color.red: i64(value), Color.blue: 9}


def main() -> i64:
    return score[bool](True, make[u8](7u8)) + scalar[i64](0, Scalar.number(table[u16](1u16)[Color.blue]))

result Number:
    ok: i64,
    err: i64


def increment[T: integer](input: Number, amount: T) -> Number:
    return Ok(input? + i64(amount))


def number[T](context: T, input: Number) -> i64:
    _ = context
    match input:
        case Number.ok(value):
            return value
        case Number.err(code):
            return 0 - code


def count[T](context: T, early: bool, input: Number) -> i64:
    _ = context
    if early:
        _ = input
        return 1
    _ = input
    index = 0
    pending: Number = Ok(0)
    while index < 3:
        _ = pending
        pending = Ok(index)
        index += 1
    _ = pending
    return index


def main() -> i64:
    return number[bool](True, increment[u8](Ok(7), 1u8)) + number[bool](True, increment[u8](Err(3), 1u8)) + count[u8](0u8, True, Err(9)) + count[u8](0u8, False, Ok(9))

enum Color:
    red,
    green,
    blue


class Point:
    x: i64
    y: i64


union Shape:
    point: Point,
    radius: i64,
    empty


def score(shape: Shape) -> i64:
    match shape:
        case Shape.empty:
            return 0
        case Shape.radius(r):
            return r * r
        case Shape.point(p):
            return p.x + p.y


def color_score(color: Color) -> i64:
    match color:
        case Color.red:
            return 1
        case Color.green:
            return 2
        case Color.blue:
            return 3


def main() -> i64:
    shapes: [3]Shape = [Shape.point(Point(x=2, y=3)), Shape.radius(4), Shape.empty]
    return score(shapes[0]) + score(shapes[1]) + score(shapes[2]) + color_score(Color.blue)
